💈 BARBER SHOWDOWN: ALL AGES 💈
Same customer. Same theme. 5 minutes. Out-cut the whole server!

🎁 CODE: BARBERSTREET for $500 + $2,500 shop cash

🏪 NEW: BARBER STREET
Own your barbershop! Build it up 3 floors and a rooftop, hire barbers who earn while you're offline, then REBIRTH for +50% income.

🛒 NEW: SHOP STORE
Auto Build, Auto Collect, Big Register, 2x Shop Cash and more, one tap away.

🎨 NEW: skin tones and ORDER mid-cut

⭐ A fair judge scores every cut 1 to 5 stars for blends, even sides, lineups and shape. Match the theme for bonus points!

HOW TO PLAY
🎡 Spin a theme: Low Fade, The Edgar, Mullet Monday...
✂️ Clippers, trimmer, razor, scissors, BLEND, dye and more
🏆 The best score wins cash and XP

MORE TO DO

👥 Crews: team up and win cash every week
🎟️ Barber Pass: 30 tiers of rewards until Dec 1
👑 Pro League: the top 3 take the lobby throne
